p.src: Money is not the same thing as income, profit, capital, or wealth.

u.src: Money is not the same thing as income, profit, capital, or wealth.
en: Money is not the same thing as income, profit, capital, or wealth.

p.src: Income is what arrives over a period.

u.src: Income is what arrives over a period.
en: Income is what arrives over a period.

p.src: Profit is what remains after costs.

u.src: Profit is what remains after costs.
en: Profit is what remains after costs.

p.src: Capital is a productive asset base.

u.src: Capital is a productive asset base.
en: Capital is a productive asset base.

p.src: Wealth is accumulated net value and durable capability.

u.src: Wealth is accumulated net value and durable capability.
en: Wealth is accumulated net value and durable capability.

p.src: Someone can have large money inflows and little wealth if they retain no ownership and save none of the surplus. Another person can look modest on an income statement while quietly building substantial wealth through assets that keep compounding.
